description: Returns one saved deal in full: the page's facts, the user's edits, every computed number, price history and notes.

key.description: A saved deal's key, as list_deals returns it (for example "zillow:12345").

anyOf.description: Strategy the numbers are computed in: buy-and-hold, house-hack, brrrr or live-in (living in it).

scoreAs.description: "saved" (default) computes each deal in the strategy it was saved in; a strategy name computes every deal in that one.

name: get_deal
